Well thats very sad.  It looks like the DESCRIPTION file in that repository is incorrect.

Ultimately the problem here is that the package hosted on Bioconductor does not contain the Repository or BiocViews field in its DESCRIPTION so its impossible to detect the origin of the package. We had a workaround in place at one time, but it got removed since it was a bit of a hack. We can look into doing something similar again. 

However if I were you, I would look into replacing the SVGAnnotation package with something else if at all possible, it doesn't seem to be maintained any more, and it's prone to breakage because of the DESCRIPTION file issue.

-Andy

On Tuesday, March 1, 2016 at 7:26:37 PM UTC+1, Andy Kipp wrote:
Well thats very sad.  It looks like the DESCRIPTION file in that repository is incorrect.

Ultimately the problem here is that the package hosted on Bioconductor does not contain the Repository or BiocViews field in its DESCRIPTION so its impossible to detect the origin of the package. We had a workaround in place at one time, but it got removed since it was a bit of a hack. We can look into doing something similar again. 

However if I were you, I would look into replacing the SVGAnnotation package with something else if at all possible, it doesn't seem to be maintained any more, and it's prone to breakage because of the DESCRIPTION file issue.

-Andy
